ISS is a proxy advisory firm, part of the Deutsche Börse Group, which in 2025 provided proxy voting research and recommendations covering approximately 52,000 shareholder meetings in approximately 100 markets worldwide to approximately 1,400 clients, substantially all of them institutional investors who rely on ISS' objective and impartial analysis to make important voting decisions.

ISS stated: "The transaction makes strategic sense due to the certainty of value and immediate liquidity offered by the cash consideration."
Separately from the ISS recommendation, in reaching its own conclusion to recommend that Shareholders vote FOR the Arrangement, the board of directors of Southstone (the "
") carefully considered several factors, including, among others, the following:
Cash Consideration. The consideration to be paid to Shareholders will be comprised entirely of cash thereby providing Shareholders with immediate liquidity and certainty of value.

Low Volume. Trading in the Shares has been subject to low volumes and infrequency of trades both prior to the halt in trading on January 10, 2024, and subsequent to reinstatement for trading on July 27, 2026, indicating that the ability of a large number of Shareholders to realize the current trading price for their Shares is highly unlikely.

A full description of the factors considered by the Special Committee and the Board is included in the Company's management information circular dated October 9, 2026 (the "
Shareholders Encouraged to Vote Ahead of the Proxy Deadline

The Board has unanimously (with the Purchaser abstaining) approved the Arrangement and recommends that Shareholders vote FOR the Arrangement and that disinterested Shareholders vote FOR the Delisting Resolution.

The proxy voting deadline for registered Shareholders is 10:00 a.m. (Vancouver time) on November 10, 2026. Non-registered (beneficial) Shareholders, being Shareholders who hold Shares through a broker, bank or other intermediary, must return their voting instruction form in accordance with the instructions on that form, well in advance of the proxy voting deadline, to ensure that their Shares are voted. Shareholders are encouraged to vote well in advance of the proxy voting deadline to ensure their vote is submitted in a timely manner. Shareholders may vote online, by telephone or by any other method provided in the form of proxy or voting instruction form included as part of the mailing.
Shareholders of record as of the close of business on October 2, 2026, are eligible to vote at the Meeting.
Any shareholder who has questions about how to vote should contact the Company's proxy solicitation agent:
